**Severity:** error · **Area:** Slots (`RV6xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
r:slot must be a string literal
```

```text
conditional r:slot branches must name the same slot
```

```text
r:slot is only allowed on a direct child of a component element
```

```text
r:slot="children": pass default slot content as plain children
```

## How to fix

Put `r:slot`="name" (string literal) only on a direct child of a component element; pass default content as plain children instead of `r:slot`="children".

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <div><p r:slot="x" /></div>;
```

```tsx prefer
declare const Card: any;
export const A = () => <Card><p r:slot="x" /></Card>;
```
